claim: Naive IID normal intervals materially under-cover the mean of a positively autocorrelated process, while a preregistered HAC correction improves coverage without guaranteeing nominal coverage.
estimand: Unconditional mean zero of stationary AR(1) processes under Gaussian and variance-standardized Student-t(3) innovations.
sample_window: Each replication uses 120 post-burn-in observations after 100 discarded initialization steps.
exclusion_rules: No replication or observation is excluded; invalid numerical results terminate the run.
primary_method: Compare empirical 95% coverage of IID-normal and Newey-West-normal mean intervals with eight Bartlett lags.
sensitivity_set: AR coefficients 0.0, 0.4, and 0.8 crossed with Gaussian and Student-t(3) innovations; 5,000 replications per cell.
decision_rule: Report cell-level coverage and Monte Carlo standard error; call under-coverage material only when the shortfall from 0.95 exceeds five target-rate Monte Carlo standard errors.
multiplicity_family: Six prespecified DGP cells form one diagnostic coverage grid; no cell is selected after simulation.
